title: Vingroup Scholarship Award Ceremony 2023
content_markdown:
# Vingroup Scholarship Award Ceremony 2023

August 23, 2023

The Vingroup Scholarship Program for Cohort 2023 has identified the 40 Vingroup Scholars who will be pursuing Master's, Ph.D., postdoctoral programs in selected science/technology at top ranked universities (University of Pennsylvania, Carnegie Mellon University, University of California San Diego, University of Sydney, University of Technology Sydney, etc.).

On July 5th & July 6th, 2023, Vingroup Scholarship Program organized the Pre-Departure Orientation (PDO) and Vingroup Scholarship Award Ceremony for 40 new scholars of Cohort 2023. These students have successfully passed all the competitive selection rounds and are commencing their programs from Fall 2023. For the first time, 10 VinUni students have been awarded Vingroup scholarships to pursue their 3+2 programs at the world's top leading universities, including the University of Pennsylvania, University of Sydney, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, University of Queensland, and University of Technology Sydney.

During Day 1 of the PDO, the Vingroup Scholars Cohort of 2023 had the chance to visit several P&Ls within the Vingroup ecosystem, including VinFast, Vinmec, and VinAI. Throughout the visit, the scholars engaged in dialogues with senior leaders and met Vingroup Scholars Alumni already working at VinFast, Vinmec, and VinAI.

Day 2 of the PDO was the Scholarship Award Ceremony attended by senior representatives from the Embassies of Australia, United States, United Kingdom, and France, along with VinUni leaders, faculty, scholars' family members and other invited guests.

Dr. Le Mai Lan (Vice Chairwoman of Vingroup, President of VinUniversity) said: "The future of Vietnam and the future of the world depend on the youth. Vingroup wishes to support and provide opportunities for talented young intellectuals to access the advanced education in the world."

The British Ambassador to Vietnam, H.E Iain Frew, and the Australian Ambassador to Vietnam, H.E Andrew Goledzinowski, also shared congratulatory remarks, noting that scholarship recipients are not required to work at Vingroup after graduation, reflecting the program's vision to invest in Vietnam's science and technology development broadly.
